notes: Gemara at Berakhot 4a:19-4b:5 directly analyzes Chachamim's 'עד חצות' ruling from Mishnah Berakhot 2a:1-5; must stay in same split family.
Both sugyot analyze whether the night has three or four watches (משמרות).
Narrative baraita of R. Yose & Elijah on not entering a ruin (3a:12-14) followed by three-reason halakhic baraita on ruins (3a:15-3b:9).
Rav Ukva bar Chama's מכנשתא דבי דרי explanation (21a:13) and R. Yitzchak's משמוש בכיסו are reused inside the יאוש שלא מדעת proof sequence (21b:6-10).
